purpose: input availability verification only; no values generated, no merge into any canonical dataset, no interpolation; no rho, no signals, no returns, no PnL, no layer execution

sources.rest_mark_price: public GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate (markPrice text, in memory only)

refusals: no merge into the canonical dataset
no float in the exact-match decision path
diagnostic candidates are never promoted to primary

candidate.comparison: Decimal on source text on both sides (no float in the path)

availability_kind_meaning.exact_conformance_verified: mark bar usable AND REST published a markPrice, so the reconstruction was checked against primary data for this settlement
availability_kind_meaning.conformance_unverified_bar_present: mark bar usable but REST publishes no markPrice for this settlement, so exact conformance is UNVERIFIED here (not refuted)
availability_kind_meaning.mark_bar_absent: markPriceKlines has no observation for the bar (P1 region)
availability_kind_meaning.mark_path_not_usable: bar exists but its mark path status is not observed/verified_repair (P2 stale, or route_unverified)

diagnostic_candidates.note: diagnostic only; does not enter the verdict and must not be used to switch the primary candidate after seeing the result
